test_title: PYST 15: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 16th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: In triangle ABC, a line through centroid parallel to BC meets AB and AC. Find ratio of area of smaller triangle to trapezium.
solution:
**Given:**

ΔABC with BC as base

G is centroid of ΔABC

Line through G ∥ BC meets AB at D and AC at E

**Formula used:**

Area ratio of similar triangles = (ratio of corresponding heights)²

**Calculations:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a1e4bd56370dba2304bd6d3598bb1104fffb73c73b84de7cf04a1c2a74b6b49.png] 

Centroid divides median in ratio 2 : 1 (from vertex)

⇒ Height of small ΔADE : Height of ΔABC = 2 : 3

⇒ Area of ΔADE : Area of ΔABC = (2/3)²

⇒ Area of ΔADE : Area of ΔABC = 4 : 9

⇒ Area of trapezium
 = 9 − 4 = 5 (parts)

⇒ Required ratio = Area of small triangle : Area of trapezium

⇒ 4 : 5

**∴ Required ratio = 4 : 5.**

5
